QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Need Fever Medicine
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bLoha#k in #bAltaire Camp#k and ask for the Fever Medicine.
QuestInfo.1:
Loha said she's out of Fever Medicine and asked that you get first-aid medicine from the exploration party.
Go to #bLohd#k who is exploring #bDesolate Land#k and get the medicine.
QuestInfo.2: You got the Fever Medicine from Lohd.

default.0: Please go and ask Lohd for the Fever Medicine. #bLohd#k should be in #bDesolate Land#k.
